The '''Tallaso system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
